config.origin_policy: last N common monthly origins with all 12 future months observed; expanding window

config.transformation: log1p(count); nonnegative expm1 inverse without mean bias adjustment
config.preparation: exclude initial partial source months; trim leading zero months; preserve all later zeros and observations; no interpolation or cleaning
config.historical_interpretation: retrospective backtest using one frozen snapshot, not real-time historical data vintages
config.score_definition: error at exactly h months; WAPE=100*sum(abs(error))/sum(abs(actual)); no pooled cross-series errors
config.interval_definition: Prophet shared simulated quantiles; forecast analytic/default model intervals; endpoints inverse transformed and clipped to zero
config.ranking: ex-post comparison; no independently held-out claim; no formal significance test for dependent overlapping errors
